caption: The drawing depicts a horse bridle, primarily constructed from braided brown leather or rope. It features sections with colorful woven patterns in shades of purple, pink, white, yellow, and black. There are multiple decorative tassels in white and cream attached to the upper straps. The lower half of the bridle incorporates metallic elements, including a silver or steel bit with attached curb chain and metal rings for attachment. The reins and straps hang down in various lengths, with some ends tied off in knots. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint rectangular border sketched in and the artist's name, Gordena Jackson, written in the lower right corner.
title: Horse Hair Bridle
